reason:
Blocked at the final step by policy, not by the application.

Everything up to submission completed successfully:
- Logged in at http://localhost:18080/parabank (the public parabank.parasoft.com host is not in the allowlist; the local instance is).
- Reached the Transfer Funds page.
- Filled the form correctly: Amount = 25, From account # = 12345, To account # = 12678 (both confirmed [selected] in the snapshot).

Clicking the "Transfer" button was refused: it is classified as an irreversible control, and this exploration is running unattended with no operator available to approve it. Reaching the confirmation screen ("Transfer Complete!") requires actually executing the transfer — there is no read-only or alternate path to that screen. I did not attempt to bypass the guardrail by POSTing to transfer.htm directly or submitting the form via script, since that would perform the same irreversible money movement while evading the approval check.

To finish recording this flow, a human needs to either approve the irreversible action, run this in an attended session, or confirm that the local ParaBank instance is a disposable test environment where the Transfer control can be de-classified. Note also that the form state is filled and ready — the only remaining action is the single "Transfer" button click.
